app_fee.value: The graduate application fee is $65 for degree and non-degree applicants (certificates pay $40).

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are limited to military-connected applicants and people on US government benefits; departments may grant program-based waivers case by case.
fee_waiver.quote: Currently only military-connected students and those receiving public assistance (from the U.S. government) may be exempt from the application fee

also.quote: Program-Based Fee Waivers are occasionally granted by academic departments on a case-by-case basis

gre_general.value: The Graduate School does not set a GRE rule; each program decides, so see the program record.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores may be required for admission to some graduate programs. Please check directly with the department regarding test requirements.

toefl_min.value: From January 21, 2026 the TOEFL minimum is 4.0 overall on the new 1.0-6.0 scale, with at least 4.0 in each section; the older catalog still says 79 iBT.
toefl_min.quote: the University of Louisville will require a minimum overall score of 4.0, with minimum sub-scores of 4.0 in each skill area

ielts_min.value: The IELTS Academic minimum is 6.5 overall, with no band below 5.

english_waiver.value: Indian citizens are not on the exempt-country list, and English as the medium of instruction does not waive the test, so a TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or PTE score is needed.
english_waiver.quote: English proficiency requirements are not waived based upon the medium of instruction at a previously attended institution. | Proof of language proficiency is waived for International Students with citizenship from one of the following English-speaking countries

notes: Sources: Graduate School pages (international applicants, English proficiency, application requirements, fee waiver) and the 2026-27 graduate catalog. The catalog's older text still shows TOEFL 79 iBT and IELTS 6.5 with no 4.0 rule; the Graduate School's proficiency page (new scale from January 2026) is used. Application fee amount is from the application requirements page. Louisville is not yet in data/universities.json (validator warning).
